items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: So, when I got in my band, for some reason I had George Boyd, Aiden Morris, Joe Gable on bass, Walter Preston on guitar, and me on trumpet.

ctx.x: Very good idea. So, my first man I worked with here was a fellow named Jack Kerri. We supposed to invent a tagger rag. And we did very nice around New Orleans, so some of the boys in the band decided me to get my own band, such as George Boyd, Walter Preston, Joe Gable, and Aidy Morris. And we got a little band together there, and we really did fine, fine, until the same thing like now, come up Lent, and we all got a job. I didn't have any when I called them to play. They couldn't go. So, I just thought I'd move…
Now tell us, how did you get your name Punch? How did you get that nickname?

items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Walter Preston... kept forcing me to quit Jack and let's get us own band... we're going to put the band in your name

ctx.x: Let me see. I bought John Jack in 20.

And I would have stayed with him all the time. And I would have stayed with him all the time. But Joy Boyer, Walter Preston, Joe Gable, Chani Foster. And them guys kept forcing me to quit Jack and let's get us own band. They did that a long time before I quit. But I said, well all right, I said we're going to put the band in your name. Kept on- I didn't want to quit Jack. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. They just kept forcing me to quit Jack and let's get us our own band. They did that a long time before I quit. But I…
Why did they want to quit Jack?
